title: AI Assistant
subtitle: Manage your questions, classrooms, students, and scores.
scopeNote: Tanya Aku AI only reads your classrooms, students, scores, and questions.
notConfigured: Connect an AI provider and select a model before asking a question.
description: Ask anything about the app: players, scores, most-missed questions, subjects, games, classrooms, teachers and AI analyses. Answers always come from the latest data.
suggestions: How is the app doing over the last 7 days?
Who is the player with the highest score right now?
Which question is answered wrong the most?
Which players have played but have no AI analysis yet?
thinking: Reading data and preparing an answer…
placeholder: Example: compare player activity this week with last week…
disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Check sources before making decisions.
privacy: Relevant data is sent to the configured AI provider. Do not include passwords, tokens, or unnecessary personal data. Conversation history is stored on the server and only available to your account.
rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then send again.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Reload the page and sign in again.
forbidden: Access denied. This feature is restricted to superadmins.
error: An answer is not available. Your question remains in the input; send it again or check AI settings.
historyError: The conversation could not be loaded. Try again.
deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.
deleteError: The conversation could not be deleted.
savedHistory: Conversations are saved to your superadmin account
teacherSavedHistory: Conversations are saved to your teacher account
teacherSubtitle: AI assistant for teachers: how to use the app, create questions and classes, and your students' scores.
teacherWelcome: Ask anything about your work as a teacher.
teacherDescription: Tanya Aku only answers about the EduFunHub app and teacher tasks: creating questions, managing classes, and the scores and analysis of students in your own classes. Other teachers' classes and students cannot be opened.
teacherSuggestions: How do I create picture questions for grade 1?
How do I create a classroom and share the PIN with students?
